A complete event-by-event atomic cascade is complicated and is not uniquely fixed by the available inclusive electron and X-ray measurements, especially in liquid Xenon experiments. We therefore use a simplified cascade model intended only to retain the leading photon–electron structure relevant for the S1–S2 response. In particular, we treat the relaxation of the initial atomic vacancy and the subsequent 125Te∗ de-excitation as two independent steps.
